query: What authentication is required for production access?

documents.title: Security policy
documents.text: Production access requires phishing-resistant MFA and quarterly access review.

documents.title: Retention policy
documents.text: Customer support transcripts are retained for 30 days unless a legal hold applies.

documents.title: Incident response
documents.text: Critical incidents require paging the on-call security lead and opening an incident record.

documents.title: Travel policy
documents.text: International travel requires manager approval before booking.

documents.text: Restricted customer data must not be copied into unapproved external systems.

documents.title: Access handbook
documents.text: Privileged production roles are granted through the access-management workflow.
